summary: Opt-in real network PostgreSQL acceptance. Owns an ephemeral database, child gateway/worker processes and failure injection; never point at production.

key_files.cluster.integration.test.ts: Three gateways, two existing durable outbox executors, four writers and real PG. Advances pending checkpoint due times only; checks snapshot convergence, recovery and notification isolation.
key_files.gateway-process.ts: Independent HTTP/SSE relay process with real PG pool and dedicated LISTEN; IPC readiness evidence only, no Loro import.
key_files.loro-cost.ts: Standalone diagnostic comparing full Loro fork costs as update and peer counts grow. Prints measurements, not timing assertions.
